title1: Software is a record of decisions.
title2: I document the wrong ones too.
description: Every project on this site lists its technical failures alongside its outcomes — the migration that locked the table, the abstraction I removed twelve months later, the metric I optimized for the wrong reason. Pretending otherwise is a debt I refuse to carry.

Code that works today is already drifting from its intent. Dependencies age, assumptions rot, and temporary decisions harden into architecture. Every project here includes the cost of keeping it alive — the refactors that removed cleverness, the features cut to preserve clarity, the parts rewritten not because they broke, but because they aged poorly.

title1: I do not aim to endure.
title2: I aim to improve under stress.
description: Breakage is signal, not failure. Pressure reveals weak abstractions, false assumptions, and misplaced priorities. Every project here carries the marks of that process — the rollback that clarified direction, the constraint that forced a simpler design, the iteration that replaced stubbornness with precision.
reason: Growth is built through stress, not avoided
